name: A320 family
measured: Type base (#759): the A320 family on the standard SimVars and key events (MSFS 2024 SDK); a model's profile (the Fenix) goes on top where it differs. The cabin signs and external power by the standard variables and events, not measured on a stock A320.

takeoffSpeeds.measured: Approximate typical A320 take-off speeds (dry runway, sea level, ISA), not from an FCOM: a starting point for the copilot's calls, to be replaced by a local override. Flaps by FLAPS HANDLE INDEX: 1 (CONF 1+F), 2, 3.

seatbelts.note: standard; the Fenix's follows its switch (measured 2026-10-05)
